headlines.title: Fastenal (FAST) Q3 Results Highlight Margin Power Behind A 3% Stock Dip
headlines.summary: Fastenal came into this Q3 2026 report priced for excellence, trading on a rich 40.8x trailing P/E after a solid 12‑month run. The stock still slipped about 3% in the first full session after the release, which suggests expectations were high and patience was thin. The headline is simple. Fastenal delivered another quarter of strong profit momentum, with Q3 basic earnings per share at US$0.35 on revenue of US$2.46b and a trailing net margin of 15.6%.

headlines.title: A Guaranteed 1.73% or a Growing Dividend? The Choice Facing Income Investors
headlines.summary: A bank will lock in your rate and hand back every dollar at maturity, while an industrial distributor has raised its quarterly payout three times in the past year alone. Which promise holds up better depends on a tax detail most investors overlook.

headlines.title: Fastenal (FAST) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Lift As Analysts Split On Growth
headlines.summary: The recent update to Fastenal’s analyst narrative centers on a slightly higher fair value estimate, which has moved from US$48.84 to US$49.84. This shift sits alongside mixed analyst commentary, with some pointing to consistent execution and others highlighting valuation and growth risks as reasons to be cautious about how much upside is left in the stock.

headlines.title: FAST Q3 Deep Dive: Market Share Gains and Digital Expansion Fuel Growth
headlines.summary: Industrial supplier Fastenal (NASDAQ:FAST) reported Q3 2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 15.5% year on year to $2.46 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.35 per share was 3.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

description: Fastenal Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the wholesale distribution of industrial and construction supplies in the United States, Canada, Mexico, and internationally. It offers fasteners, and related industrial and construction supplies under the Fastenal name. The company's fastener products include threaded fasteners, bolts, nuts, screws, studs, and related washers that are used in manufactured products and construction projects, as well as in the maintenance and repair of machines. It offers miscellaneous supplies and hardware, including pins, machinery keys, concrete anchors, metal framing systems, wire ropes, strut products, rivets, and related accessories. The company serves the manufacturing market comprising original equipment manufacturers; maintenance, repair, and operations customers; non-residential construction market; farmers, truckers, railroads, mining companies, schools, and retail trades; and oil exploration, production, and refinement companies, as well as federal, state, and local governmental entities. Fastenal Company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Winona, Minnesota.
